harness.notes: js/audio.js exports class Audio (shadows the DOM Audio only inside the module) and has no imports. The AudioContext is created by a 'wake' listener on keydown/pointerdown, so init dispatches a synthetic keydown on window. The tune is generated from a seeded LCG (64 steps, beat = 60/bpm/2), so it is deterministic; loop = 64 steps.

notes: Seeds are fixed in TUNES, so each render is identical to in-game.
